newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Nov sugar exports ex-key ports below 1995.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Nov sugar exports ex-key ports below 1995.

text.p: Brazilian sugar shipments from key ports reached 635,976 tonnes in November against 793,312 tonnes exported in the same month last year, individual port authorities said.
Bulk sugar shipments from the terminal operated by the Santos Codesp port authority reached 80,827 tonnes against 4,858 tonnes in the same month last year.
Bulk sugar shipments from Cargill's private terminal totalled 35,990 tonnnes, down from the 77,880 tonnes exported by the terminal in November 1995.
November bagged sugar shipments were 141,564 tonnes, down from the 264,926 tonnes shipped in November 1995.
In Paranagua, bulk sugar shipments reached 37,378 tonnes and bagged sugar 107,217 tonnes against 15,400 tonnes bulk and 32,422 tonnes bagged in the same month last year.
In the north/northeast region, sugar exports out of Maceio were down on last year, reaching 114,000 tonnes against 1995's 191,150 tonnes. Both figures were for bulk sugar.

In the port of Recife, bulk shipments in the past month reached 43,000 tonnes against last year's 120,427 tonnes while bagged sugar exports totalled 76,000 tonnes, below the 86,249 tonnes shipped last year.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
